title: Patch: a signature animation for every Core Legendary and Mythic, one concept per card
notes: Core's ten Legendaries and Mythics get their signatures (R3402001): an entrance or cast of each card's own, its text's beat, a permanent's own aura, a Mythic's takeover with full-screen art, and a sound each; a bespoke recipe may wear an aura and a signature's own cast replaces the shared rays (R3402000).

player.title: Core's Legendaries and Mythics, each its own
changes: Every Core Legendary and Mythic now has an animation of its own, each built from what the card does.
Silly Silas pirouettes down a spotlight, and his Cry spins the field under a mirrorball.
Transmogulate tips a crucible over your hero, and Pocket Chaos swaps its pair through a velvet pocket.
Unlicensed Experimentation bursts open into a hatch and welds its catch; Call to Chaos spins a slot-wheel.
My Pawn, Zephrys, Heroic Power and Craft a Card take over the screen with art of their own.
With Reduce Motion on, that art stands still behind the card.
Silly Silas, Combo-Index and Heroic Power wear a glow of their own while they stay on the board.
Each of the ten has a sound of its own. Your opponent's face-down traps and hidden cards still show nothing.
